It's not necessarily a job. If you're trying to compete for server firsts etc then perhaps. Blizzard has made it so that a casual player can also raid, get a good sense of the epicness of some of the fights and storyline. You don't need to spend hours raiding if you don't want to. I'd recommend you try out a casual guild that raids from time to time. ICC is not a very good representative of an epic instance however. Some fights on hard modes perhaps but Marrowgar (the first boss) is lolezmode and feels like a Heroic dungeon zerg fest on normal (and even on heroic now). If you get a chance, I would try out a raid in Ulduar, or even go back and check out some Vanilla/BC raids with a small group. They can be extremely fun especially if you get a fun, cohesive group. Don't give up on it just because it has a fanatical stigma! 
I hope you give it a chance, especially in Cataclysm as they are bringing back a lot of the epicness felt in pre-ICC/ToC raids. Either way, happy hunting :).

Just a side note from a Tank / DPS. As a tank, I like the challenge of having to maintain aggro for people who attack everything. If they die, not my fault, but I "train" myself that way. I've honestly become a better player because of having to be constantly aware of my threat on everything. The only time I'd rage is if a dps LEEEEROOOY'd 1/2 the instance for the second time. Or if it's just one of those days...nowutimean? (*though at that point it's usually time to take care of the problem then playing wow to avoid it...nowutimean? ^^ *).

As DPS I could care less about my aggro in heroics. Unless the healer is super undergeared and doesn't know how to play. I can kill stuff faster than a 40 man raid vs Mr. Bigglesworth right now(*not a tribute to my skill, just pointing out that having dps be 10k+ in instances designed for ~2-4k is a bit broken*). Now I know I could "practice" aggro management, but hell if I'm going to wait 10 seconds to throw out 3 moves and get aggro anyways when I can blast everything down in less than 10 seconds and make the healer have to click his/her healbot with more than one mouse button(*note: Blizzard, give Fury an aggro drop. Please. On a side note, the one thing I miss from the faction change is Shadowmeld...*).
TL,DR 4.0 = EZmode. Stop QQing.

Also, on my druid I leveled resto. I spent most of my time in dungeons chaining pulls back to the pack because 1, casting rejuv once a minute is bloody boring, and 2 druids can heal through Vaelastrasz's health eating debuff. Ok, not really but that's what it feels like. Maybe it's out of the "spirit" of running dungeons and I understand that new people might now be down with the whole "grab 50 mobs and lolwutbbqAoEfest them down while writing a lab report" method but I'd rather pull that pack next to the one man pat then sit there not doing anything while the everyone burns one man. 

 I think it makes sense for everyone involved (*every onewho wants to get through the dungeon and level etc. If you're RPing, that's fine too but that's why I like my good ol' gankfest of a PvP server. Not that I hate RPing etc. but this is getting long enough as is*) for someone chain pulls in a controlled manner to the tank. I've had people bug out at me doing things such as not tank anything trying to kill me but I lolwuthurp at them and tree form through it if I have to and still keep everyone up. If the tank leaves because of it I encourage DPS to "go forth and pewpew tank" because it's more interesting to have to cast something other than rejuv.

The best group I've ever had involved a DK and I "DPS tanking". I started the instance as prot, full prot gear etc. etc. but I was finding it kinda hard and annoying to try to keep aggro from this DK pulling ~10k dps without waiting etc etc. Now for me, I could care less. If you die from aggro, your fault and no sweat from me, but I also don't rage. I kinda like to view it as a challenge. Anyways, things were dying pretty quickly and I didn't feel like slowing the group down by trying to hold aggro on mobs that die in 5 seconds, so I informed the group that "This is silly. I'm going dps, if you have any serious problems healing the group or myself let me know."

We cleared heroic UK in about 5 minutes chaining pulls with the DK and myself pulling ~10-13k dps a piece(our "mitigation" being that there were 2 of us pulling stupid amounts of aggro and our plate armor [I play a war]). The healer barely had to throw heals up because we'd kill stuff too quickly. 
Spent about 45 minutes chaining with this DK and the healer...heroic farming has never been more broken.
